sources.title: NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 - GitHub
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 is an open vision-language-action (VLA) model for generalized humanoid robot skills. This cross-embodiment model takes multimodal input, including language and images, to perform manipulation tasks in diverse environments.

sources.title: Omkar Patil
sources.snippet: Personal webpage of Omkar Patil, PhD @ ASU Diffusion models have been extensively leveraged for learning robot skills from demonstrations. These policies are conditioned on several observational modalities such as proprioception, vision, and tactile. sources.title: GR00T-WholeBodyControl - GitHub
sources.snippet: This is the codebase for the GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC) projects. It hosts model checkpoints and scripts for training, evaluating, and deploying advanced whole-body controllers for humanoid robots.
